name: Trusted environment acquisition for private menu runtime
phase: Discovery and specification only; implementation requires separate explicit authorization
architecturalPurpose: Extract one structurally compatible narrow menu database capability from explicitly supplied trusted environment inputs. Keep capability acquisition separate from private menu composition, request/session acquisition and activation.

repositoryEvidence.databaseType: FoodD1Database from src/lib/food/d1-draft-persistence.ts: prepare(sql): FoodD1Statement and batch(statements): Promise<readonly FoodD1Result[]>; statement bind/all are used later, not probed during acquisition.
repositoryEvidence.composition: FOOD-002H takes database, readDependencies, callerResolver and administratorPrincipalId; constructs repository/service/workspace synchronously and returns frozen service/workspace without a result envelope.
repositoryEvidence.readDependencies: FoodMenuReadDependencies = Pick<FoodDraftRepository, 'getProduct' | 'getRecipe'>; these injected exact-read operations are not an environment binding and must not be acquired or invoked by I.
repositoryEvidence.configuredBinding: No canonical menu D1 binding is declared in wrangler.jsonc or worker-configuration.d.ts. Existing declarations are commerce, CRM, Sesh and identity; none is a menu fallback.
repositoryEvidence.foodTarget: RIVER_FOOD_DB is an architectural draft target in FOOD-001F/H records, not a configured binding. FOOD-002G explicitly does not assume menu/draft database co-location. Do not silently repurpose this draft target as the menu binding.
repositoryEvidence.generatedTypes: worker-configuration.d.ts declares Cloudflare.Env/Env and is generated by wrangler types. No menu type or configuration change is needed for the structural injected boundary; later approved binding declaration may require regeneration.

food001FPrecedent.input: FoodPrivateDraftRuntimeAcquisitionInput { environment: FoodPrivateDraftRuntimeEnvironment; callerResolver: SessionPrincipalResolver }, where environment has RIVER_FOOD_DB?: unknown and RIVER_FOOD_ADMIN_PRINCIPAL_ID?: unknown.
food001FPrecedent.behavior: Reads exactly two named food keys; validates database prepare/batch, canonical administrator and injected resolver.resolve. Synchronous and I/O-free, then delegates to E composition. Does not acquire global Cloudflare environment or construct sessions/resolvers.
food001FPrecedent.failure: Fixed sanitized configuration-unavailable result; catches malformed dependencies and throwing getters. No alternate keys or fallback.
food001FPrecedent.trust: Caller supplies environment provenance and request-scoped resolver. Structural validation does not establish live database/schema/session/trust properties.
food001FPrecedent.exposure: F returns authorized service or K service/gate bundle, not raw environment or database. I deliberately differs: only a database capability is acquired for later H assembly.
food001FPrecedent.reuseDecision: Reuse structural validation, no-I/O acquisition and configuration-unavailable discriminated failure pattern. Do not call F, copy its administrator acquisition or compose E/H inside I.

acquisitionContract.inputDefinition: export interface FoodPrivateMenuEnvironmentAcquisitionInput { readonly environment: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>; readonly bindingName: string; }
acquisitionContract.resultDefinition: export type FoodPrivateMenuDatabaseAcquisitionResult = Readonly<{ ok: true; value: FoodD1Database }> | Readonly<{ ok: false; error: Readonly<{ code: 'configuration-unavailable'; message: 'Food menu database configuration is unavailable.' }> }>;
acquisitionContract.success: Return Object.freeze({ ok: true, value: database }) with value exactly the selected binding object. No wrapper/proxy/copy around the database, no raw environment or bindingName field in output.
acquisitionContract.bindingSelection: bindingName is an explicit trusted composition/configuration input, never request-derived. This is a single-key extractor, not automatic general-purpose discovery: read environment[bindingName] once, never scan keys or attempt alternatives.
acquisitionContract.bindingNameValidation: Require a string matching ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$ exactly. No trimming, normalization, coercion, empty value or default. This validates key syntax only, not menu ownership or configured existence.
acquisitionContract.reasonForExplicitName: No existing canonical menu binding name can be inferred. Parameterizing the one trusted key permits isolated unit implementation without choosing or introducing a production configuration key. A later approved integration must lock the selected menu binding and target; accepting a key is not permission to use an unrelated database.

validationOrder: Require non-null non-array object outer input; capture environment and bindingName once in that order. Ignore unrelated outer fields without reading them.
Require non-null non-array object environment and validate exact bindingName syntax before any environment property read.
Read only environment[bindingName] once. Require non-null non-array object database with callable prepare and batch; check prepare then batch without invoking either.

Catch all property-access/validation failures into the same frozen sanitized configuration-unavailable result. Do not inspect statement methods, enumerate environment, access unrelated fields or perform probes.

failureSemantics.failure: Object.freeze({ ok: false, error: Object.freeze({ code: 'configuration-unavailable', message: 'Food menu database configuration is unavailable.' }) })
failureSemantics.cases: Missing/null/array/non-object input/environment/database; invalid/missing bindingName; absent selected property; missing/noncallable prepare/batch; throwing input/environment/method getters or proxies.
failureSemantics.separation: No throws for acquisition validation failures. Keep configuration-unavailable separate from H construction TypeErrors and E's authorization/operation results. Acquisition does not translate or invoke H errors.
failureSemantics.privacy: Never include key names, dependency values, environment dumps, IDs, secrets, thrown exception text, stacks or SQL details in failures; do not retain failed inputs.
failureSemantics.noFallback: No in-memory persistence, alternate configured databases, draft target inference, global discovery, provisioning or null/undefined success.

trustBoundary: Only a trusted server integration supplies environment provenance and the bindingName identifying its approved menu target. Do not accept these values from a request, body, query, cookie or public API.

Structural compatibility cannot prove the selected object is D1, belongs to the menu, points to an approved target or provides primary consistency. Those remain trusted caller/integration responsibilities.
The acquired database is a privileged infrastructure capability for trusted composition callers, not a public/service response and not a reusable caller authorization token.
Do not infer trusted request, authenticated session, permitted administrator or authorization from acquisition success. FOOD-002E still authorizes fresh on every operation.
purity: Synchronous, deterministic structural extraction only. Zero SQL, prepare/batch/statement calls, FOOD-001 reads, authorization, request/session resolution, network, schema probes, migrations or provisioning.
No import.meta.env, process.env, Cloudflare globals/imports, Astro locals, request/server-context acquisition, Wrangler inspection or generated environment imports.
Freeze only result/error containers; do not freeze, mutate, clone, rebind or proxy environment or database. Preserve database method receiver behavior by returning the original object.

relationshipToH.laterAssembly: After successful acquisition, a later trusted integration supplies acquired.value as database to createPrivateFoodMenuRuntimeComposition({ database: acquired.value, readDependencies, callerResolver, administratorPrincipalId }).
relationshipToH.boundary: I does not import/call H or construct repository, service or workspace. On failure no H composition occurs. H input/output and existing narrow factories remain unchanged.
relationshipToH.deferredDependencies: Exact FOOD-001 read capabilities, canonical administrator sourcing/configuration, request-appropriate caller resolver, session/identity construction and actual trusted environment acquisition remain later integration responsibilities. Do not acquire them from environment in I.
